subject: Remove subject
body:
Dear Amir,

Could you please help me to remove subject 90847 from study 3519?
In agreement with the participant, she was invited but will now start at a later timepoint due to holiday, namely starting today. We have dropped the participant from the study, but now for some reason cannot delete the participant (network issue… but we can do everything else on our laptops that require internet connection). As we would like to re-invite the participant with the same email address the previous participation needs to be fully deleted, as now invitation is not possible as ‘this participant is already part of the study’.

Thank you very much for the help!

Best regards,

Eva Vanbrabant
